dedupe_keys.name: downscaled global 60 m irrigation water sources groundwater or surface water 2000 2015

description: Global maps of whether cropland is irrigated and from which water source. The Scientific Data paper (9 October 2025) says the dataset gives the likely irrigation status (rainfed or irrigated) and water source (groundwater or surface water) of croplands at 60 m for 2000, 2005, 2010 and 2015, by downscaling the 10 km GMIA irrigation data with 30 m cropland patterns, nearby surface water and crop water requirements, and was validated with Indian household surveys (8,355) and a US database of 1,505,371 wells, reaching 85 per cent accuracy near US wells. The maps are a free download on figshare (doi 10.6084/m9.figshare.c.7318916) and viewable in Google Earth Engine; the paper is under CC BY. Coverage is global croplands. Caveats: sources are inferred, not observed. For simulation it shows which farms depend on groundwater pumps and so on electricity, and which on canals and rivers, for drought and power outage studies. A related catalogue record is the FAO global map of irrigation areas.
